content:
Coast to Coast AM with George Noory

An intriguing photo snapped by an Australian woman shows what she believes is the arm of a Yowie, the Bigfoot of Down Under, reaching for some food. The thought-provoking image, which came to light a few weeks ago, was reportedly taken on April 19th as witness Belinda Kay was camping in the southeastern part of the country. Recounting the excursion, she noted that it was fraught with weird events, beginning with her being struck by a mysterious pebble while walking her dog. "It came from nowhere," she said, "I felt like I was being followed. I was quite paranoid." However, this was just the start of a strange series of days that may have culminated in a Yowie encounter.

Check out Kay's photo of the possible Yowie arm and find out more on this story at the Coast to Coast AM website.
